name: Open Card - Attachable List
purpose: Opens the "Files" card window on the Attachable list layout, sorted by creation time newest first, and goes to the first record.

name: btn: Add New File as FileAttachment to Invoice
purpose: Invoice button: lets the user pick a file (images and office documents), works out file name, content type, Image or Document category and size in KB, adds an attachment row in the Invoice attachment portal with the file stored in an Attachable record, and flags the invoice to send to QuickBooks.
writes:
Invoice_AttachableRef::EntityType#6 (step 35, portal row, creates a related record)
Invoice_AttachableRef_Attachable::Container#17 (step 42, related via Invoice_AttachableRef_Attachable, can create the Attachable)
Invoice_AttachableRef_Attachable::FileName#6 (step 47, related via Invoice_AttachableRef_Attachable)
Invoice_AttachableRef_Attachable::ContentType#10 (step 48, related via Invoice_AttachableRef_Attachable)
Invoice_AttachableRef_Attachable::Category#11 (step 49, related via Invoice_AttachableRef_Attachable)
Invoice_AttachableRef_Attachable::FileSizeKB#25 (step 50, related via Invoice_AttachableRef_Attachable)
Invoice::qbo_send#3 (step 53, current record)
$File (Insert File step 7, container variable)
external: Insert File (step 7, file picker, embedded container)
open_question: Exit Script at step 68 returns $result, which is never set. Content type is mapped for only 9 extensions; others give an empty content type (bmp, tif, xls and others). The entity type stored is the layout table name (step 24). Embedded file bytes live in a container field, so storage in the target is open.

name: btn: Add Existing File as FileAttachment to Invoice
purpose: On the Attachable card list: flags the selected Attachable for QuickBooks send, closes the card, adds an Invoice attachment row pointing at the picked attachable id, sets its entity type to Invoice, flags the invoice to send, and reopens the card list.
writes:
Attachable::qbo_send#20 (step 7, current record)
Invoice_AttachableRef::AttachmentId#8 (step 24, portal row)
Invoice_AttachableRef::EntityType#6 (step 31, portal row)
Invoice::qbo_send#3 (step 33, current record)
open_question: Step 7 runs before the parameter is read at step 14 and before the card closes (step 9), so the Attachable flagged is the card list current record. Exit Script at step 47 returns $result, which is never set.

name: btn: Download File and Open (filename)
purpose: Exports the attachment container to a temporary path under the given file name and opens it with the default app, from the card list or from the invoice attachment portal.
external: Export Field Contents (steps 6, 9; Get(TemporaryPath), automatically open)
open_question: Download to the browser replaces this in the target. Step 12 is a disabled leftover.
